def: The reed bunting. It has a collar of white feathers. Calledalso ring bunting.
One who respects. A respecter of persons, one who regards orjudges with partiality.Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons. Acts x.34.
Recording; -- applied to instruments; having an apparatus whichregisters; as, a registering thermometer. See Recording.

Without stain or blemish; spotless; undefiled; clear; pure.Were but my soul as pure From other guilt as that, Heaven did nothold One more immaculate. Denham.Thou sheer, immaculate and silver fountain. Shak.Immaculate conception (R. C. Ch.), the doctrine that the Virgin Marywas conceived without original sin.-- Im*mac"u*late*ly, adv.-- Im*mac"u*late*ness, n.
Performance to, or obtained from, valerian root; specifically,designating an acid which is usually called valeric acid.
One who thrusts in the banderillas in bullfighting.  W. D.Howells.
Drying oil; a substance mingled with the oil used in oilpainting to make it dry quickly.
A morass; a shallow lake. [Written also jhil.] [India]Whitworth.
The long-tailed duck. See Old Squaw.
